import json
p='eval-log/run-dev-graph-system-spec-intermediate.jsonl'
rows=[json.loads(l) for l in open(p,encoding='utf-8') if l.strip()]
last=rows[-1]
row={"round":3,"original_goal":last["original_goal"],"original_goal_hash":last["original_goal_hash"],
"current_goal_snapshot":"evaluator PASS 後の同一payloadでC02 dry-run→確定add (rev0→1)。specification/architecture 2 node が source_lineage/confirmation_evidence/readiness complete を保持。lineage/schema/coverage/citation gate exit0、integrity auditor PASS、R3独立verifier(sonnet) PASS",
"delta_from_original":"inner checklist 6項目全achieved。OUT1 は live trial 判定待ち (external_pending)",
"merged_directive_for_next":"なし (完了)。OUT1 は run 後の live trial が判定",
"drift_signal":"none"}
open(p,'a',encoding='utf-8').write(json.dumps(row,ensure_ascii=False)+"\n")
PY
DEV_GRAPH_ROOT='/private/tmp/claude-501/pr86-ci-live/lt/runs/sysspec116/fx' && python3 - "$DEV_GRAPH_ROOT/eval-log/run-dev-graph-system-spec-goal-spec.json" "$DEV_GRAPH_ROOT/eval-log/run-dev-graph-system-spec-intermediate.jsonl" <<'PY'
import hashlib, json, sys
goal = json.load(open(sys.argv[1], encoding='utf-8'))
rows = [json.loads(line) for line in open(sys.argv[2], encoding='utf-8') if line.strip()]
required_keys = {'original_goal','original_goal_hash','current_goal_snapshot','delta_from_original','merged_directive_for_next','drift_signal'}
expected = hashlib.sha256(goal['original_goal'].encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()
assert rows, 'intermediate.jsonl is empty'
for row in rows:
    assert required_keys <= row.keys(), required_keys - row.keys()
    assert row['original_goal'] == goal['original_goal']
    assert row['original_goal_hash'] == expected
print("rows", len(rows), "ok")
PY
echo exit=$?
